title: thfproject
description: THFproject is an infinite void world with structures where players receive a random item every 30 seconds. Starting with nothing, players use creativity and luck to build bases, survive, and PvP.
body:
THFproject is an infinite void world with all natrual structures generating where players receive a random item every 30 seconds. 

The server is both java and bedrock. the port for bedrock is 25566
